prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1029; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the intersection, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a side impact. Driver 1 was operating a gray sedan northbound and reported the traffic signal for their direction had been green. Driver 2, operating a white pickup truck eastbound, stated they entered the intersection after the signal had changed to yellow. The front driver's side of the sedan struck the passenger side of the pickup. A Passenger was seated in the front right seat of the sedan and was not reported injured at the scene. Driver 1 was conscious, reported pain in the left wrist, and was transported by EMS to a local hospital for evaluation. Driver 2 declined medical attention. Both vehicles sustained heavy damage and were towed from the scene. Skid marks were noted on the roadway. Witness statements were collected, and traffic signal timing records have been requested from the city. Citation status is pending completion of the investigation.
